limitations: Browser actors, API and Stripe responses are synthetic; this is not connected-backend or payment-provider acceptance.
No main merge, production deployment, migration, customer order, refund, provider activation or live email occurred.
The prior 24-stage hosted preview and 118-case profile suite are older-source evidence, not a rerun for this candidate.
Only Chromium at the two recorded widths was exercised in this run; no Firefox, WebKit or physical-device claim.
retainedInitialFailures: Unwired reader import in owner-state harness; repaired by loading the real reader without relaxing its cases.
Pre-existing status source assertion expected owner payment confirmation; replaced with exact permitted-status, no-confirmation and acknowledgement assertions. Server unchanged.
First browser attempt stopped for missing synthetic payment build key; Unicode in new test was also corrupted by the initial PowerShell stdin encoding. Original logs retained.
